parked.spanish: A fin de que traigan hijos de Israel sus sacrificios que ellos sacrificantes sobre faces del campo, y los traigan a Jehová a abertura de tienda de reunión, al sacerdote, y sacrifiquen sacrificios de pazes a Jehová a ellos.

findings.issue: אוֹתָם is the direct-object marker plus a 3mp suffix (them), not a dative. “a ellos” can stand as that tonic object, but the same “a” used for לַיהוָה can be read as a second recipient.

parked.spanish: Porque alma de la carne en la sangre ella, y yo la di a ustedes sobre el altar para expiar sobre sus almas, porque la sangre ella en el alma expiará.

findings.issue: Object suffix is 3ms; la is feminine, so the given participant is no longer the masculine token and can be read as the feminine soul.
Pronoun is 3ms; ella is feminine and matches the earlier 3fs pronoun instead.
